children: Summit Therapeutics reported that partner Akeso presented HARMONi-2 data showing ivonescimab improved overall survival versus pembrolizumab in PD-L1-positive NSCLC.
Ivonescimab reduced risk of death by 27% vs pembrolizumab (HR=0.73; 95% CI 0.57–0.95; p=0.009) in HARMONi-2 interim OS analysis.
Median overall survival improved to 30.8 months for ivonescimab vs 22.6 months for pembrolizumab (median follow-up 36.0 mos).
Strong benefit in PD-L1 high subgroup: HR=0.58 (95% CI 0.38–0.89); benefit also observed across squamous and non-squamous histologies.
Safety remained manageable: higher serious TRAEs with ivonescimab (29.9% vs 21.6%) but similar discontinuation rates (4.1% vs 5.0%).

Summit is conducting global Phase III HARMONi-7 (PD-L1 high NSCLC, co-primary PFS and OS) and other ivonescimab trials; ivonescimab is approved in China but remains investigational in Summit’s territories.
